logic.note: The first logic engine: QuickJS (quickjs-emscripten, single file) and the logic core, behind the shell's second lock; code as a JS module with no buffers, a seeded Math.random and a frozen Date, work counted in ticks, called as call, see, hook or view with one JSON text in and out

lib-three.note: three.js r186 with OrbitControls, MapControls, TrackballControls, RoundedBoxGeometry, ConvexGeometry, BufferGeometryUtils, SkeletonUtils, ImprovedNoise, SimplexNoise, Sky, RoomEnvironment and Line2 for a draw script

lib-d3.note: d3 7.9.0 for a draw script, as a module and as the global d3

lib-mcp-apps.note: The MCP Apps SDK (@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps 2.0.3, its dependencies bundled) for a draw script

view.note: The first view engine: a view's HTML made safe and drawn from its state, our components, charts and look, its draw script in a worker
Templates work through the sanitizer: a <template>'s each, as and if attributes are kept (v1 dropped them, so loops and conditions drew nothing)

view-worker.note: The first view worker: a draw script on a linkedom DOM mirrored into the frame, canvases as ImageBitmaps, MCP Apps over parent.postMessage, module imports as lookups
